answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a scarce token stake before it may post bids or claim rewards, then slash that stake when a challenge proves the identity double-claimed or violated a shared rule. A rotating, randomly selected jury checks signed interaction records, so copying a name alone is not proof. The ledge is the minimum stake threshold; juniper and nectar can label test agents in the audit. An attacker must fund each sybil separately and risks losing every bond, making scale costly rather than free.
